indirect_calls.why: The public RT1170 TONE build registers only ToneEncoder. WavGenerator::stop dispatches Encoder::stop to that concrete adapter.
The public RT1170 TONE build registers only ToneEncoder. WavGenerator::fail stops that concrete adapter after a failed job.
In the public TONE firmware, begin dispatches encoder setup/status/length/stop to ToneEncoder and the WAV header write to the fixed FileSink in rt1170/tx_artifact.cpp.
In the public TONE firmware, step dispatches sample/status/failure-stop calls to ToneEncoder and PCM writes to the fixed FileSink in rt1170/tx_artifact.cpp.
The public TONE job supplies the firmware's fixed FileBytes object as the WAV writer's payload source.
ToneEncoder configures itself and reads payload through the WavGenerator ByteSource adapter in the public TONE job.
The public TONE adapter reads its payload through the WavGenerator ByteSource adapter.
GCC 14 labels start_generation.part.0 as 0() in this image; its two indirect calls are the registered TONE descriptor constructor and the corresponding virtual Encoder destructor.
